system.description: Closed Essence 14.3.3 - Earth Mastery. Spells to dig, tunnel, and wall off earth and stone, animate earthen hands and arms, phase through earth, and toughen the caster's own skin.
Caster learns the origin and nature of any natural earth, stone, or metal.
Caster can relocate packed earth at the rate of 1 cubic foot per minute. Dirt can be relocated anywhere within 10' radius of target area.
Caster gains a +25 to all caving, underground survival, and direction sense rolls (while underground).
Creates a wall of earth up to 10'x10'x3' at base, 1' at top. This wall can be dug through.

This spell causes earth and stone tendrils to rise up out of the ground and attack anything within their area of effect. The tendrils attack as a +0 Medium Grapple attack. Alternatively, the GM may allow the caster to develop a skill called Targeting for Earth Fingers (Power Manipulation Skill Category). If the GM allows this skill, all attacks that use this bonus requires that the caster concentrates.

For the duration of the spell, the caster has +15 HPs and reduces criticals by 1 level. Any spells cast from any other list while this spell is active is at -15. Any damage done to the character affects the 15 HPs of the Earthskin first and never hits the caster. So when the spell is over the damage does not transfer over.
As Dig, except that stone may be relocated at the rate of 1 cubic foot per minute or earth may be relocated at 2 cubic feet per minute.
Creates wall of stone up to 10'x10'x3' at the base, 1' at the top. This wall can be chipped through.
As Earthwall, except range and duration.

As Earth Fingers, except causes a huge hand to rise up out of the ground. The hand can attack with a +50 Large Grapple anything the caster chooses within the area of effect. After being held, the target takes a 50 Large Crush attack each round. Target may make a RR each round (using his strength bonus as his level) versus the caster's level. If successful, the target escapes the hand.

Caster can merge into any earth, stone or metal inanimate object or wall. While merged, the caster cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The caster cannot move 'through' material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet. The caster can exit at any time during the spell duration.

Allows caster to alter the shape of up to 1 cubic foot per level of any stone or metal material by molding it with his hands. The shape formed lasts until the duration ends, and then is affected normally by the environment.
As Earthskin, except gains +45 HPs and reduces criticals by 2 levels. All spells cast from any other list while this spell is active is at -45.
Caster can phase through any earth, stone or metal inanimate object or wall at a rate of 2' per round.
As Stone Wall, except duration is permanent.
Caster can see through natural earth or stone to a depth of up to 1' per level.

As Earth Hand, except a pair of huge (5' diameter, 10' long) earth and stone arms rise out of the ground within the area of effect and attacks the target of the caster's choice with a +100 Huge Grapple Attack. If the attack causes a 'C' critical or better, the victim is enveloped and begins to suffocate. If the caster concentrates then the victim will take an 'E' Crush critical each round. Target may make a RR each round (using his strength bonus as his level) versus the caster's level. If successful, the victim escapes the arm.
As Earthwall, except range and duration.
As Earth Molding, except for duration.
As Earthskin, except grants caster AT 16 for the duration of the spell.
As Earth Phasing, except caster can move at a rate of 10' per round.
As Stone Wall, except creates a 50'x10'x1' wall.
Caster can use one lower level spell on this list each round.
